title: 小鹏顾宏地：智驾订阅收费，技术到位后商业化才可行？
speaker: Brian Gu

segments.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see. I want to get your take on autonomous driving as well, because starting from second quarter of next year, your AI smart driving will also become a paid subscription from buyers.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是商业世界曲线中非常令人兴奋的部分。我也想听听你对自动驾驶的看法，因为从明年第二季度开始，你们的AI智能驾驶也将向买家收取订阅费。

segments.en: Can you tell us why you decided to have sort of charging now? What sort of take rate are you expecting?
segments.zh: 能告诉我们为什么决定现在收费吗？你预期怎样的订阅率？

segments.en: Well, first of all, I think this is very consistent to the development process that we have for autonomous driving.
segments.zh: 首先，我认为这与我们自动驾驶的发展进程非常一致。

segments.en: I think only when the technology reached a point that, you know, you can generate a consumer, you know, real trust value and dependence, then I think commercialization is feasible.
segments.zh: 我认为只有当技术达到一定程度，能够产生消费者真正的信任价值和依赖时，商业化才可行。

segments.en: We saw, you know, obviously, you know, outside of China, FSD is actually really, you know, showing good trajectory of, you know, getting software subscription as a business model because it displayed that kind of capabilities in technology.
segments.zh: 我们看到，在中国以外，FSD实际上展现出良好的发展轨迹，将软件订阅作为商业模式，因为它在技术上展示了那样的能力。

segments.en: We are very confident that expand next year was obviously the intended improvement as well as international expansion will be able also to showcase superior autonomous driving capabilities.
segments.zh: 我们非常有信心，明年的扩展显然是预期的改进，国际扩张也将能够展示卓越的自动驾驶能力。

segments.en: So for that level of technology, we think commercial model and also commercial revenue stream is very appropriate, but we also will maintain a base level of autonomous driving for our, you know, every day, obviously the normal driving.
segments.zh: 因此，对于那个技术水平，我们认为商业模式和商业收入流非常合适，但我们也会为日常正常驾驶保持基础水平的自动驾驶。

segments.en: So to appreciate from the high end sophisticated driving conditions, so I think that there's a way I think once you showcase the technology, I think that there's a chance to really see increased in penetration around the opportunity and subscription levels.
segments.zh: 所以，从高端复杂驾驶条件中获益，我认为一旦展示了技术，就有机会真正看到渗透率在机会和订阅水平上的提升。

segments.en: Can you tell us a bit more about, I mean, you mentioned a little bit of FSD. Do you think that you'll be able to charge less than Tesla's FSD?
segments.zh: 能多告诉我们一些吗？你提到了一点FSD。你认为你们能比特斯拉的FSD收费更低吗？

segments.en: Well, I don't think at the moment we have really discussed the exact exact pricing yet, but also you're based on what we viewed as sort of the adaptive, the pricing for the vehicle, as well as price pricing for the subscription.
segments.zh: 嗯，我认为目前我们还没有真正讨论确切定价，但也是基于我们所认为的适应性，车辆定价以及订阅定价。

segments.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year.
segments.zh: 所以这些都还在整合中。我认为大概要到明年第二季度、接近我们推出这类业务模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。
